name: Landmark: Grand Torii Portal
description: Monumental crimson Torii gate silhouette standing in still reflecting mountain water.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game landmark icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a colossal Japanese Torii gate archway with subtle red beam accents. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Sharp clean vector lines, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
